outcome.answer: The closest matches are [4] and [2]. [4] combines embedding-based clustering with iterative LLM inference to build an interpretable topic taxonomy from unlabeled text, assigning consistent topic labels across clusters. [2] is a topic-modeling framework that uses semantic embeddings, TF-IDF, metadata, and consensus clustering for stable partitions and iterative refinement, but it focuses more on robust topic modeling than on an automated taxonomy pipeline.
